CREATE SEQUENCE "antares_fixtures"."products_id_seq"
   START WITH 1
   INCREMENT BY 1
   MINVALUE 1
   MAXVALUE 2147483647
   CACHE 1;

CREATE TABLE "antares_fixtures"."products"(
   "id" integer DEFAULT nextval('antares_fixtures.products_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL,
   "name" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'unnamed'::character varying NOT NULL,
   "price" numeric DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
   "tags" text[],
   "created_at" timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
   "category_id" integer,
   "data" jsonb,
   "flag" boolean DEFAULT false,
   "status" "antares_fixtures"."product_status" DEFAULT 'draft'::antares_fixtures.product_status,
   "weight" "antares_fixtures"."Weight" NOT NULL,
   "size" "antares_fixtures"."dimensions",
   CONSTRAINT "products_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "products_name_uq" ON "antares_fixtures"."products" ("name");
CREATE INDEX "products_price_idx" ON "antares_fixtures"."products" ("price");
